title: Four-bar linkage
about: A parallelogram four-bar: a ground with two pivots 60 mm apart, a crank and a rocker 30 mm long (two of one part), and a coupler 60 mm long. Its fourth joint makes a loop. At the start the loop's sides meet, so nothing warns; turn the crank alone and they don't, so the loop joint warns how far apart they are, and moves nothing.
commands: run --save Ground.sb feature.add_box size=80,20,10 corner=-10,-10,0 name=Block
run --open Ground.sb --save Ground.sb feature.add_cylinder radius=2 height=10 name=HoleA
run --open Ground.sb --save Ground.sb feature.add_cylinder radius=2 height=10 base=60,0,0 name=HoleD
run --open Ground.sb --save Ground.sb feature.add_boolean operation=cut a=Block b=HoleA name=CutA
run --open Ground.sb --save Ground.sb feature.add_boolean operation=cut a=CutA b=HoleD name=Ground
run --save Crank.sb feature.add_box size=40,10,4 corner=0,-5,0 name=Bar
run --open Crank.sb --save Crank.sb feature.add_cylinder radius=2 height=4 base=5,0,0 name=NearHole
run --open Crank.sb --save Crank.sb feature.add_cylinder radius=2 height=4 base=35,0,0 name=FarHole
run --open Crank.sb --save Crank.sb feature.add_boolean operation=cut a=Bar b=NearHole name=Near
run --open Crank.sb --save Crank.sb feature.add_boolean operation=cut a=Near b=FarHole name=Crank
run --save Coupler.sb feature.add_box size=70,10,4 corner=0,-5,0 name=Bar
run --open Coupler.sb --save Coupler.sb feature.add_cylinder radius=2 height=4 base=5,0,0 name=NearHole
run --open Coupler.sb --save Coupler.sb feature.add_cylinder radius=2 height=4 base=65,0,0 name=FarHole
run --open Coupler.sb --save Coupler.sb feature.add_boolean operation=cut a=Bar b=NearHole name=Near
run --open Coupler.sb --save Coupler.sb feature.add_boolean operation=cut a=Near b=FarHole name=Coupler
run --save Linkage.sb assembly.new
run --open Linkage.sb --save Linkage.sb component.insert file=Ground.sb
run --open Linkage.sb --save Linkage.sb component.insert file=Crank.sb count=2 at=0,40,0 step=0,20,0
run --open Linkage.sb --save Linkage.sb component.insert file=Coupler.sb at=0,90,0
run --open Linkage.sb --save Linkage.sb joint.add kind=revolute "a=Ground 1:edge:15" "b=Crank 1:edge:3" name=Crank value=60
run --open Linkage.sb --save Linkage.sb joint.add kind=revolute "a=Ground 1:edge:16" "b=Crank 2:edge:3" name=Rocker value=60
run --open Linkage.sb --save Linkage.sb joint.add kind=revolute "a=Crank 1:edge:16" "b=Coupler 1:edge:3" name=Coupler value=-60
run --open Linkage.sb --save Linkage.sb joint.add kind=revolute "a=Crank 2:edge:16" "b=Coupler 1:edge:4" name=Loop

change.command: run --open Linkage.sb --save Linkage.sb joint.set joint=Crank value=90

warnings.apart: sqrt((a*cos(radians(q)) + b*cos(radians(q-rk)) - d - a*cos(radians(rk)))**2 + (a*sin(radians(q)) + b*sin(radians(q-rk)) - a*sin(radians(rk)))**2)

change.about: turn only the crank, to 90 degrees: the coupler turns with it, and its far end leaves the rocker's, so the loop warns how far apart they are.
